Definition
[Ricci eigenvalues in the rotational ansatz (36.9--36.10)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0335 ↗ def:chow-iv-rotational-s3-metric 1. ch36:36.9,ch36:36.10\group Numerical Simulation

The radial and tangential Ricci eigenvalues are \begin{align*} R_\perp & =-2e^{2(W-X)}[-1+X”+W”+(X’+3W’)\cot \psi +2(X’+W’)W’],\\ R_{S^2}& =-e^{2(W-X)}\bigl[-2+(1-e^{-4W})/\sin ^2\psi +X”+W” +(3X’+5W’)\cot \psi +(X’+W’)(X’+3W’)\bigr]. \end{align*}
